No. 2439/57 – THURSDAY, JUNE 05, 2025
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Revocation under Section 39 (1)

THE allotment of land specified morefully in the Order No. 313 of 2012 dated 18.12.2012 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1789/29 dated 19.12.2012 was vested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. The possession of the land depicted below has not yet been taken for and on behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 39(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke order made in respect of the the lands specified in the Schedule of the Order No. 313 of 2012 dated 18.12.2012 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1789/29 dated 19.12.2012. K.D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.

My No.: 4-3/10/2012/LRB/09. Land Acquiring officer's No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/JP/01.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Land Secretariat,No.1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla.20th May, 2025.
